Before filing, please read the rules in
[docs/CONTRIBUTING-DATA.md](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING-DATA.md).
Provenance and a redistribution basis are required for every record.

**The dataset**

Material, number of tests, and what each test carries. Per-cycle evolution
data is especially welcome.

**Provenance**

Where the data comes from: your own tests, a published paper, or a public
dataset. Include the citation or DOI if published.

**License basis**

The license or permission under which the data can be redistributed.

**Format**

Whether it is already in the `test-record@1` or `collection@1` interchange
format, or raw. `lcf-validate` checks any document from the command line.
